answer: Seating is by invitation, and each member inherits the meadow of its oldest ancestor. The k-th seat anywhere below one inviter is admitted only when members of k other meadows each sign a signal for it and lock one relic, which they forfeit if that seat is expelled. An honest stranger, first under its inviter, needs one outside signal and one relic. An operator's 100th clone needs signals from 100 foreign meadows, so 100 clones need 5,050 signals and relics from unrelated members, each paid enough to risk losing their relic.
